page.layout: One printed page: a centred title block in black letter and roman, then a woodcut ornament below it, with a small mark at the lower right.

main_text.l: dieses Auctoris, auß den besten Scribenten

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the title block and the lower mark: a central face with scrolls and foliage, with a pendant below. The page number "257" is printed at the top in old-style figures. The lower-right mark is a single decorative letter, read as "R" with a doubt. Lines ending in a hyphen are hyphenated in print. Spelling is kept as printed; "vnnd" and "vnd" are given as "unnd" and "und" under the u/v rule.
